rules.readOnlyBlock: New records, edits, deletions and new calculations are not possible.
rules.recordsKept: Your client and analysis records are kept when you move to Pro membership.
rules.modules: Your module access is limited to the modules your administrator has enabled for your account.

rules.demoClosed: Backup, restore, export and password change are disabled on the demo account.
rules.reviewClosed: Access to modules is closed until the review is complete.
rules.noPackageClosed: Access to modules is closed until a package is defined.
